# TreeView replaces base input handling but delegates generic display events

The base handles expansion, scrolling and empty-space focus. The derived TreeView supplies selecting click/keyboard rules and filters those events to its table body; its default branch delegates to the base. The original split still leaves shared selection machinery in the base, while accepted code later creates TreeSelection in the derived view setter. Keep those phases separate, with no fresh keyboard or screen-reader result.

Scope: Tree widget base and selection event contracts.
